reason: The free first visit is an easy yes and the clean, never-packed setup is what I'd want on a rainy Saturday. After that I'd pay the weekend drop-in once, maybe twice a month, but I wouldn't commit to a membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, so unlimited at $45 doesn't pay off, and $15 a visit on a weekend adds up if it's only a few times. I also don't know if it will be fun enough to keep a toddler busy past the first visit.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend drop-in closer to $10-12, or a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire for a few months.
